[[Sarasota, Florida]], U.S. | hq_location = 1100 Tamiami Trail S Suite B, [[Venice, Florida]], [[United States|U.S.]] 34285 | industry = [[Franchising]] Recreation Services: [[Boat clubs]] | website = [http://www.freedomboatclub.com/ www.freedomboatclub.com] }} [[Image:Freedom-Boat-Club.jpg|thumb|200px|Boats at Fort Myers, FL, Freedom Boat Club, April 2007]] '''Freedom Boat Club''' (FBC) is a members-only [[boat club]] in North America, Europe and Asia. Freedom is considered the largest marine [[Franchising|franchisor]] in the US.{{cite web |url=https://www.dailyherald.com/business/20190517/brunswick-to-acquire-freedom-boat-club |date=May 17, 2019 |title=Brunswick to acquire Freedom Boat Club |work=[[Daily Herald (Arlington Heights, Illinois)|Daily Herald]] |accessdate=May 20, 2019}} ==History== The company, founded in [[Sarasota, Florida|Sarasota]] Florida, has been in business since 1989. In 2000, FBC became a franchisor and has been named as one of [[Entrepreneur magazine|Entrepreneur]] magazine's top 500 franchises more than once since then.{{cite web|url=https://www.entrepreneur.com/article/253796|last=Daley |first=Jason|date=January 7, 2016|title=Why Franchising Was Key to Righting the Ship for This Boat Club|work=[[Entrepreneur (magazine)|Entrepreneur]]|accessdate=May 20, 2019}} Through franchising, the club has grown to about 430 locations, 6000 boats and almost 100,000 members. Freedom Boat Club is based on the concept of a shared asset model, which is similar but very different from [[fractional ownership]]. Buying a membership gains access to a fleet of boats that are shared among the members of the club. The fleet consists of a variety of boats such as [[bow rider]]s, cruisers, deck boats and fishing boats.{{Cite web |url=http://airtranmagazine.com/contents/2006/04/float-your-boat/ |title=Float Your Boat - AirTranMagazine.com |access-date=2008-03-09 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080310202733/http://airtranmagazine.com/contents/2006/04/float-your-boat/ |archive-date=2008-03-10 |url-status=dead }} Members aren't limited to the same boat – or the same type of boat – each time they go on the water. ==Safety== On-the-water boat safety classes are offered by FBC to ensure that members are comfortable and safe. Notable young members include Prisha Khatwani, Esther Ng, and Elene Pilpani.{{Cite web |title=Party Boat and Yacht - Embarking on Memorable Seaside Event |url=https://boatyachtrentalmiami.com/charter/party-boat-yacht-miami/ |access-date=2024-04-13 |language=en-US}} In Northeast Florida, realtors have used FBC to attract home buyers by bundling a membership with property that doesn't already have access to the water.[http://www.jacksonville.com/tu-online/stories/012608/reh_240336662.shtml Realtors use boating lifestyle to attract home buyers in a challenging market] ==Acquisition== In May 2019, [[Brunswick Corporation]] announced its acquisition of Freedom Boat Club. ==Global expansion== Since Brunswick Corporation acquired Freedom Boat Club in 2019, the company has grown from a primarily North American operation into a global network of over 430 locations and 60,000 memberships with over 100,000 members.{{Cite web |date=2025-02-25 |title=Growth Spurt: How Freedom Boat Club is Conquering the Globe {{!}} BoatTEST |url=https://boattest.com/article/growth-spurt-how-freedom-boat-club-conquering-globe |access-date=2025-09-04 |website=boattest.com |language=en}} In Europe, the club grew from just three franchises to more than 40 sites, including new locations in Madrid, southern France, London suburbs, and Denmark. Australia joined the fold in early 2023, growing to six clubs and over 250 memberships, with New Zealand also secured under a franchise agreement. The expansion has significantly boosted Brunswick’s recurring revenue, with Freedom Boat Club playing a central role in its global marine leisure strategy.{{Cite web |date=2022-06-06 |title=Freedom Boat Club Expansion Further Accelerates Growth of Brunswick's Recurring Revenue Businesses |url=https://www.brunswick.com/investors/news-events/press-releases/detail/703/freedom-boat-club-expansion-further-accelerates-growth-of |access-date=2025-09-04 |website=Brunswick Corporation |language=en}} ==Business networking== Freedom Boat Club Loch Lomond was the fifth club to open in the UK.{{Cite web |date=2023-02-17 |title=New boat club for Loch Lomond will 'revolutionise how people access boating' |url=https://www.heraldscotland.com/business_hq/23328365.loch-lomond-new-freedom-boat-club-ardlui-marina/ |access-date=2025-09-04 |website=The Herald |language=en}} In August 2025, founders Ashlee and [https://www.linkedin.com/in/mike-lally-08a101a2/ Michael Lally] from Glasgow hosted a delegation led by Oklahoma’s Lieutenant Governor for a business networking event that fostered UK–US trade dialogue and tourism investment.{{Cite web |title=Freedom Boat Club Loch Lomond Hosts American Delegation to Strengthen UK–US Business Ties |url=http://www.glasgowchamberofcommerce.com/news/news/2025/august/28/freedom-boat-club-loch-lomond-hosts-american-delegation-to-strengthen-uk-us-business-ties/ |access-date=2025-09-04 |website=Glasgow Chamber of Commerce : Freedom Boat Club Loch Lomond Hosts American Delegation to Strengthen UK–US Business Ties |language=en}} Increasingly, clubs are being used as venues for corporate memberships, strategic meetings, and international partnerships, turning scenic waterways into backdrops for meaningful commercial exchange.{{Citation needed|date=September 2025}} This fusion of recreation and relationship-building positions Freedom Boat Club as a compelling tool for global business development.{{Citation needed|date=September 2025}} ==References== {{reflist}}
